items.item_text: Bachelors degree in business, clinical engineering or related field.
Masters degree preferred.

Minimum of 10 years of total experience in technology or hospital operations with a substantial portion of this time in managing technology services in a health care environment in a multi-hospital organization.
Minimum five (5) years of experience working in the field of information technology or with integrated biomedical devices.
Must have experience in managing large inventories (>50,000 devices) of medical devices throughout their lifecycles.
Experience in managing large-scale (capital) projects that include healthcare technology management (CT, MRI, Clinical Laboratories, physiological monitoring, etc.).
Extensive experience in leading, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams and producing project results within schedule and budget.
Strategic & Operational Leadership
Provide executive leadership and governance for the HTM organization, ensuring achievement of service level agreements, fiscal responsibility, and accreditation and regulatory compliance.
Align with and deploy operational standards, service models, and performance metrics to ensure safe, consistent, and reliable medical technology operations across all facilities.
Capital Planning & Execution
In collaboration with HTMs Technology Coordination Group develop regional capital and operating equipment plans informed by asset condition, lifecycle, utilization, and clinical need.
Oversee execution and deployment of approved plans, including progress reporting and communication with market and regional leadership.
Enterprise Integration & Technology Enablement
Ensure effective integration of medical devices with IT architecture, EHR, and CMMS in alignment with national HTM standards and enterprise service models.
Partner with KPIT, Nursing, Operations, Facilities, and NSSO teams to support reliable system performance and technology enabled care delivery.
Clinical Risk, Quality & Compliance
Oversee comprehensive medical equipment maintenance and support programs using established CMMS and best practices to support patient safety, quality, access, and operational efficiency.
Establish processes to identify, monitor, and mitigate clinical technology risks across the market.
Asset Lifecycle, Inventory & Disposition

Lead programs for medical equipment redeployment and disposal in a financially, environmentally, and regulatory compliant manner, including management of hazardous materials, licensed components, and ePHI.
Ensure accurate asset inventories are maintained in the enterprise CMMS in partnership with HTM CMMS leaders.
Financial Management
Lead development and management of the regional HTM operating and capital budgets, supported by benchmarked staffing models, utilization forecasts, and long range operational projections.
Ensure appropriate financial controls, reporting, and accountability are in place to support sustainable operations.
Stakeholder Partnership

Serve as a key partner to Care Delivery Operations, Facilities, Finance, HR, KPIT, and other enterprise and regional stakeholders to align HTM services with organizational priorities and care delivery needs.

Demonstrated seasoned background of leading, building relationships, and influencing senior matrix executives with a cooperative, risk-taking, fact-driven consultative style balanced by a strong results and customer service orientation.
Active role in Technology Management organizations is preferred.
Must be able to work in a Labor/Management Partnership environment with Union staff.
The position requires up to 75% travel to any of KPs regions. Must be able to travel at least 50% of the time.

Must have executive-level presentation skills, appropriate for presentations to the division, various market leadership forums, market executive forums as well as the many leadership and peer forums within these structures. Presence in region as advocate for Healthcare Technology Management issues/solutions.
Knowledge of strategic planning for health care organizations, healthcare technology management and divisional operations.
Competent knowledge in principles of medical devices and systems inter-operability, architecture, engineering, and construction as they relate to healthcare technology management.
Working knowledge of compliance issues applicable to healthcare technology management operations (e.g., The Joint Commission, CMS, Sarbanes Oxley, Food and Drug Administration, etc.).
Demonstrated enterprise-wide, vertical and horizontal communication skills (written, presentations, oral and listening).
